one_line_proposition: Technology: Cardiac motion energy harvesting (1-40 μW) + 100μF capacitor + duty-cycled sensing. Problem: Battery replacement requires surgery every 5-8 years. Eliminates self-powered sensing..
target_application: Battery replacement requires surgery every 5-8 years. Eliminates self-powered sensing.
why_you_may_care: A computationally specified P-15 concept plus a preregistered decisive experiment — not a validated technology.

current_evidence.evidence_summary: See evidence ledger — 4 evidence atoms across 6 tiers

what_is_not_proven: Arrhythmia model (70% reduction) more aggressive than published (10-30%)
strongest_alternative: Lithium battery (finite life, 5-8 years, requires replacement surgery)
decisive_question: Actual cardiac harvesting in target implant location. Whether 10 μW is achievable in shunt geometry.
if_pass: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)
